description: 50-question multi-hop benchmark for the memory-hq vs GBrain head-to-head per task_plan-gbrain-integration.md. Questions span platform-history (infra changes, retired services), agent decisions (per-business memory atoms), and operator-relationship (people / vendor entities). Each requires ≥ 2 hops to answer correctly.
instructions: Run with `node scripts/eval-memory.mjs <adapter-name>`. Each question is asked of the chosen memory adapter (memory-hq or gbrain). The runner grades by checking whether the answer mentions the `expected_atoms` slugs (substring match, case-insensitive). v1 = a simple slug-citation check, not full-answer NLP grading.
